Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2018
ACT VII OF 2018
BAHAWALPUR DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(REPEAL) ACT, 2018
An Act to repeal the Bahawalpur Development
Authority Act, 1991
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
20th March, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(182)/2018/1723, dated 20.3.2018.---The
Bahawalpur Development Authority (Repeal) Bill 2018, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 14, 2018, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on March 19, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to repeal the Bahawalpur Development
Authority Act, 1991 (XI of 1991) so that Bahawalpur Development Authority may
be constituted under the provisions of the Development of Cities Act, 1976
comparable with the Authorities constituted in many other cities of the Punjab,
inter alia, for orderly and planned growth of the city of Bahawalpur.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as
follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Bahawalpur Development
Authority (Repeal) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Repeal of the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991

3. Savings.---Notwithstanding
the repeal of the Bahawalpur Development Authority Act, 1991 (XI of 1991), any
rules, regulations or appointments made, orders passed, notifications issued
contracts entered into, proceedings commenced, rights acquired, liabilities
incurred, penalties, rates, fees or charges levied, things done or actions
taken under the provisions of the repealed Act shall continue to have effect
unless repealed, recalled, withdrawn or cancelled.
